summary: As of 2011, the Abu Dhabi government has phased out subsidies for certain livestock feed crops that consume up to 33% of total water consumption. It's all part of an ongoing effort to increase the use of electric cars in the emirate and cut down on fuel consumption. The move was announced under the directives of Sheikh Saud bin Saqr Al Qasimi, Ruler of Ras AlKhaimah.
